title: Apply for your Type D student visa
whatHappens: If your course lasts longer than 90 days, you need a National Type D visa (a short Type C Schengen visa covers shorter stays). The consulate checks four things: your Universitaly approval, proof of roughly €7,000 available for the year, health insurance, and proof of accommodation in Italy.
whoDecides: The Italian consulate in your country of residence — not the university, not Kimere.
timing: Book your consulate appointment as soon as your Universitaly file is approved; slots fill up fast in peak months.
whatCanGoWrong: Proof of accommodation is usually the hardest requirement to meet from abroad — see the accommodation step below.
whatKimereDoes: We prepare your file to the standard the consulate expects and brief you on the interview. The decision is theirs; we make sure your file isn't the reason it goes wrong.
